messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Jack,

Viridian Energy Consulting's leadership search across solar, storage and renewable project delivery makes this a focused introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibility across ESG and social performance, government and regulatory relations, external affairs, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder coordination.

I am internationally mobile and open to Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where energy transition, responsible development and institutional engagement intersect.

My executive CV is attached for your consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
